notes.title: Release Date Update: 2026
notes.content:
[p]Hellooo Cottage Dwellers!!
[/p][p]We know maaany of you are eagerly awaiting the release of Virtual Cottage 2. Right now, we are hard at work to get the game finished and we have some very cool features planned.[/p][p][/p][p]We are super excited for you to see what we've been cooking!!! [/p][p][/p][p]BUT it will take a little while longer until you can play it 😭 🙏  We are aiming for a Q2 2026 release. It's still too early for an exact date, and it might even take us a bit longer.[/p][p][/p][p]On the upside, we are already doing beta tests right now and are aiming to get a demo finished a lot sooner. notes.title: Closed Beta has begun!
notes.content:
Hello ^^

We know you're all thirsty for Virtual Cottage 2. As of yesterday, the closed beta has begun and so far the feedback has been overwhelmingly positive. We'll now spend the coming months implementing the feedback and fixing bugs. Once we are satisfied, there will be a public demo. 

Regarding release date, we don't know ourselves! We'd like to release the game in 2025 but we also want to release the best game possible and we are in the lucky position to have no outside pressure or financial needs to ship it as fast as possible. 

We already have a very solid game that we are now expanding on, which might lead to a release in 2026 because there's lots of stuff to come we haven't even announced yet! :)

If you want to stay up to date on all news about Virtual Cottage 2 join our [url=https://discord.gg/E2tR2mQ2KX]discord[/url].

notes.title: Virtual Cottage 2!
notes.content:
Dear Friends,

When we launched Virtual Cottage in October 2020 as our first game/app on Steam, we had no idea where it would lead us.

We initially intended to create a screen blocker to help you focus on your work and avoid distractions like social media.

However, over the years, you have all shared valuable ideas, feature requests, and ways you interact with Virtual Cottage. It became clear to us that a significant overhaul was due.

So, we're thrilled to present Virtual Cottage 2! It comes with three different timers (Classic Timer, Stopwatch, and Pomodoro) and an improved To-Do List (rearrange tasks, create categories, and set up repeating daily routines). This time, you’ll also be able to add your music. 

But now, the most requested feature of all time (we heard you loud and clear!): [b]Cottage customization[/b]. 

You will be able to choose between different room layouts in the beginning and add more as time goes by. The game will also offer a wide selection of furniture items to place inside your home. We wanted you to have the ability to create your ultimate cozy space! You will get rewarded one item (and its colour variations) per day, simply by using Virtual Cottage. And yes, there will be pets…this time, you won't have to choose between them—you can have them all active simultaneously!

We are super excited about this and hope you are as well!! 

If you wanna be up-to-date with the development or leave us some more input, you’re welcome to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/E2tR2mQ2KX]discord[/url] :)
